channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Shape Arts: Emergent Residency 2026/27 (Tate St Ives / Porthmeor Studios)
item.description: Shape Arts, with Tate St Ives · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 3,000 bursary for the selected residency artist (restricted to artists living or working in Cornwall, Devon or Somerset). Disabled artists in the rest of the UK can join the shortlisted cohort, which brings mentoring and profile but no stated bursary. No application fee.

item.title: Tate x Delfina Foundation: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (London)
item.description: Tate and Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Non-salaried but fully supported: return economy-class flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement and visa support via Delfina Foundation, a living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, a London Underground and bus travel pass, a single bedroom at Delfina Foundation with shared facilities, and travel to other Tate galleries and UK/European cultural institutions. The Leonora Carrington fellowship adds a research resource allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Delfina Foundation x Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation: Open Call for Artists from Portugal and Portuguese-Speaking African Nations (London residency)
item.description: Delfina Foundation, in partnership with the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation (UK Branch) · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Twelve-week fully funded residency: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials budget of GBP 1,200, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. No application fee.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.
